title: US government probe into postdoc visas worries scientists
title_zh: 美国政府调查后博士签证让科学家担忧
abstract: The administration says that the universities being investigated are using the visas to undercut wages for US nationals, but researchers say that restricting international applications could harm science.
abstract_zh: 行政部门称，正在调查的大学利用这些签证压低美国国民的工资，但研究人员警告，限制国际申请可能会损害科学研究。
snippet: The administration says that the universities being investigated are using the visas to undercut wages for US nationals, but researchers say that restricting international applications could harm science.
